versions.title: Back to School Fits

skins.name: Cherry Varsity
skins.story: She cheers louder than anyone in the bleachers, so the school gave her a cherry varsity jacket with a cream star on the chest to prove it.

skins.name: Mocha Beats
skins.story: He walks to class with his mint headphones on and his knit sleeves pulled over his hands, nodding along to beats only he can hear.

skins.name: Plaid Wrap
skins.story: She never actually wears her green flannel, she just knots it around her waist and pushes up her round glasses whenever she has a better idea.

versions.note: The first bell rings and the crew shows up in their best school-day layers: a cherry varsity jacket, a cosy knit with big headphones and a green flannel tied around the waist.

versions.title: Skatepark Summer

skins.name: Checker Flip
skins.story: He has landed exactly one kickflip in his life, but he wears his teal cap backwards and his checker shoes like he lands them every day.

skins.name: Tie-Dye Sky
skins.story: He dyed the shirt himself in the backyard and swears the spiral is a map of the sky on the night he got his first skateboard.

skins.name: Peach Overalls
skins.story: She keeps one strap undone on purpose, twists her pink hair into two space buns and paints daisies on everybody's skateboard.

versions.note: School is out and the crew takes over the skatepark: a kickflip kid in checkerboard shoes, a tie-dye dreamer with sunglasses in his hair and an overall girl with pink space buns.

versions.title: After Dark Drip

skins.name: Frost Puffer
skins.story: She zips her ice-blue puffer up to her chin the moment the sun goes down and never leaves the house without her navy pompom beanie.

skins.name: Night Runner
skins.story: He runs the same loop around the block every night, and his reflective stripes flash in the headlights like a tiny comet.

skins.name: Retro Breaker
skins.story: His windbreaker is louder than his music, three colours crashing across it, and his yellow bucket hat has never once seen rain.

versions.note: When the streetlights come on, the crew heads out in their night fits: an ice-blue puffer with a pompom beanie, a runner with reflective stripes and a colour-block windbreaker under a bucket hat.
